args.summary: Deployed hotfix v2.3.2 of checkout-api to all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west). Reason: prior production version v2.3.1 was unhealthy with an elevated error rate of 18%. v2.3.2 had never been healthy in production previously, so the deployment was routed for change-manager approval per policy, then rolled out. This incident records the change; verify error rates return to normal post-deploy.

Recommended follow-up: monitor error rates across the three regions to confirm v2.3.2 is healthy, and resolve INC-0001 once the service stabilizes.
